CustomField.description: Automatically indicates whether this employment is active based on its start date and end date.
CustomField.formula: AND( Start_Date__c <= TODAY(), OR( ISBLANK(End_Date__c), End_Date__c >= TODAY() ) )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: This field is calculated automatically. An employment is current when it has started and has no end date or an end date of today or later.
CustomField.label: Is Current As Of Today
